༄༅/ /mthar thug don gyi snying po zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /mthar thug don gyi snying po zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

mthar thug don gyi snying po zhes bya ba/ dpal kun tu bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mgon po gdod nas myogs sangs khras/ /'od gsal rin chen dag pa'i sku/ /dri med zab cing khra che ba/ /hrun gyis grub la phyag 'tshal lo/ / gzhi dang gzhi snang khyad par las/ /kun bzang sems can grol dang 'khrul// 'khrul pa bzlog tshul 'bras bur bcas/ /bdag gis kyogs bzhin bshad kyis nyon/ /'khor dang 'das pa gang gis kyang*/ /gos pa med pa'i sngon rol na/ /rang byung ye shes ka dag nyid/ /ngo bo stong pa mtshon baṇod 'das/ /rang bzhin 'od las gting gsal tshul/ /thugs ṇe rig pa'i snying po can/ /nang dbyings dag pa chen por gnas/ /ngo bo skur gnas 'pho 'gyur med/ /rang bzhin 'od las gsung nyid 'char/ /thugs ṇe thugs te rig par gnas/ /sku ru gnas kyang zhal phyag med/ /'od du gnas kyang kha dog med/ /rig par gnas kyang 'phro 'du med/ /rang ngo nang gsal 'char gzhi'i cha/ /sku las sku gsum nyid dang ni/ /'od las hrun grub longs spyod myogs/ /thugs ṇe rig pa ye shes su/ /ngang gis 'char ba'i gzhi mar gnas/ /'di ni gdod ma'i gnas lugs so/ /gzhi las gzhi snang snang tshul la/ /nang dbyings gting gsal hrun grub nyid/ /rlung gis phyir g.yos rang gdangs shar/ /hrun grub khra kha ral ba'i tshe/ /shar lugs drug dang sgo gnyis snang*/ /rig pa nang gsal gcig po la/ / rig gdangs rlung gis g.yo ba yis/ /nang mdangs phyi ru bskyod pa ste/ /thugs ṇai bra bur rang shar bas/ /rig pa'i rang byal gdangs la 'jug /'od brar shar bas 'ja' tshon bzhin/ /thams cad dbyings snang dag par gdal/ /sku brar shar bas tshom bu'i sku/ /mtha' dbus med par kun la khyab/ /ye shes bra bur rang shar bas/ /dag pa'i zhing khams mngon du gyur/ /gnyis med bra bur rang shar bas/ /mi kyog ting 'dzin rang ngor gnas/ /mtha' grol bra bur rang shar bas/ /thams cad zang thal mtha' dbus med/

/ma dag 'khor ba'i sgo brar shar/ /'gro drug snang ba phyi lam bzhin/ /'og tu gsal te stong gzugs bzhin/ /snang ba 'di yod 'khrul khrur gnas/ /dag pa ye shes sgo brar shar/ /myang 'das rang snang ka dag gzhi/ /gyen du gsal te nam mkha' bzhin/ /snang ba 'di yong grol khrur gnas/ /shar lugs drug ni gyes gzhi la/ /sgo gnyis rang rang 'jug sgor snang*/ /'jug pa 'khor 'das so so'o/ / 'di dag gzhir snang shar tshul lo/ /de tshe kun bzang grol tshul ni/ /thugs ṇe'i byal gyi gzhi snang kun/ /rig pa'i rang snang shes pa yis/ /yul phyir ma shes 'gyu ba kun/ /rang thogs chod pas gyam par grol/ /rig gdangs thugs ṇe'i shar tshul de/ /'gro la babye ba'i thugs ṇer gyur/ /'od sku ye shes shar ba yang*/ /rang du kyogs pas thad kar chod/ /gnyis med brar shar dgongs par gsal/ /mtha' grol brar shar dbyings gcig kyogs/ /'khor ba'i sgo nyid sgyu mar kyogs/ /dag pa'i sgo la rang thim nas/ /dag pa ye shes nyid kyi sgo/ /gzhi snang bcas pa ngo bor thim/ /shel 'od nang du bsdus pa bzhin/ /thog ma'i nang dbyings chos skur gnas/ /thams cad ye shes dag pa'i klong*/ /ye sangs khras la yangs sangs khras/ /kun bzang gzhi la grol tshul ni/ /de yi kun la lam bstan pas/ /'khor 'das kun gyi dpal zhes bya/ /grol tshul 'di 'dra da bra yang*/ /yod ces sprul pa'i skyes mchog gsungs/ /der ma zad de chos 'di yis/ /gang grol rab 'bring tha ma kun/ /gzhi snang gzhi las mthar phyin nas/ grol bar phyogs mthun shes par bya/ /'on kyang gzhi thog grol ba de/ /'khrul ma myong bas ma rig dag /rang mal g.yos pa med par grol/ /rab 'bring tha ma'i gang zag gyams/ /'khrul nas lam sbyangs grol ba'i phyir/ /bye brag de brar shes par bya/ /kun bzang grol ba'i tshul bstan pa'o/ /ma rig sems can 'khrul tshul la/ /gzhi snang shar ba'i snang ba la/ rang snang yin par ma shes te/

/ kren bzhi dmigs pa ma dag pas/ /thag pa sbrul 'dzin bzhin du 'khrul/ /khru yi kren ni ma rig gsum/ /rang ngo ma shes hran cig skyes/ /hran cig skyes pa'i ma rig dang*/ /ma rig sbags pa'i rig pa de/ /ma rig nyid dang hran cig pas/ / bdag nyid gcig pa'i ma rig dang*/ /rig byal 'gyu ba yul la spyod/ /kun tu bkyags pa'i ma rig pa/ /gsum gyis khru yi kren byas te/ /bdag kren rig pa snga ma nyid/ /nang dbyings ye shes gyam gsum las/ /ngo bos yul gyi go phye la/ / rang bzhin lus dang gyam par phye/ /rig pa sems kyi 'khrul gzhir gyur/ /de phyir bdag kren rig pa nyid/ /ga pur gcig gis sman dug bzhin/ /kyogs na grol ba'i kren yin yang*/ /ma kyogs 'khrul kren nyid du snang*/ /dmigs pa'i kren ni gzhi snang nyid/ /rang gdang yin yang gzhan brar snang*/ /dmigs pa'i yul du rang snang bas/ /thag sbrul tho yor mir snang bzhin/ /bkyags na thag pa tho yin yang*/ /sbrul dang mir 'khrul 'jigs pa bskyed/ /gzhi snang rig gdangs rang yin yang*/ /gzhan du bzungs pas 'khrul kren byas/ /mtshungs pa de ma thag pa'i kren/ /ma rig sbags pa'i rig pa dang*/ /gzhi snang dus mtshungs gyur pa las/ /'khrul par dngos su grub pa ste/ /'od dra bsgribs shing rig pa brlag /ma rig sems ni bag chags pas/ /yul don sems ni 'khor bar snang*/ /de phyir de ma thag kren ni/ /mtshon dang lus gnyis reg mtshungs pas/ /phya yis zug ḍur gyur pa bzhin/ /de brar kren bzhi ma dag pas/ /rang byung ye shes chen po yang*/ /gzugs med gzugs dang 'dod pa yi/ khams gsum 'khor ba'i gnas su 'khyams/ /lus ngag sems kyi khyos pas bcings// 'khrul snang bde sdug bag chags dbang*/ /dbyings las g.yos pa med bzhin du/ /rang snang 'gyur bas g.yos par snang*/ /'gro drug mgal me bzhin du 'khor/ /dper na rang mal ma g.yos par/ /phyi lam yul 'khor bakhrud pa bzhin/

/bde sdug mtho dman srid par snang*/ /'di ni 'khrul pa'i byung tshul lo/ /'khrul pa bzlog pa'i thabs la gnyis/ /rang bzhin shes par bya ba dang*/ /shes nas mngon du bya ba 'o/ /rang bzhin shes par bya ba ni/ /'khrul dus sems can thams cad la/ /rang byung ye shes chen po de/ /til 'bru las ni mar bzhin du/ /ye nas kun khyab chen por gnas/ /tsit+ta rin chen gzhal yas na/ /dngas ma'i kyen la gnas pa ni/ /snum dang sdong bu zhun mar bzhin/ /rang gdangs 'od dra'i klong na bzhugs/ /ngo bo ka dag stong pa nyid/ /rang bzhin hrun grub gdangs dang bcas/ /thugs ṇe rig pa byal dang bcas/ /ye shes gsum gyi tshul du gnas/ /de las zer gdangs 'phros pa yis/ /dung khang khro bo'i skur gsal la/ /bya gyams nang na thig ler gsal/ /rlung gis 'phro dang 'gyu bar gnas/ khyad par ka ti shel sbugs can/ /dar dkar snal ma phra la 'khril/ / 'di bzhi'i nang na 'od dang zer/ /thig le thig phran ye shes rlung*/ /khru bas ye shes snang ba ston/ /'od bya'i rang gdangs lu gu khrud/ /thig les bakhran pa de yin no/ /'di dag 'phel dang dag pa yis/ /las rlung zad de gzhi snang grol/ / ka dag rang gnas de bzhin no/ /ye shes gnas tshul bstan pa 'o/ /shes nas mngon du bya ba la/ /gzhi lam 'bras bu gsum nyid las/ /gzhi ni rig pa byang chub sems/ /sgo gsum dri mas bsgribs pa de/ /dag cing smin par bya ba'i phyir/ /dbang bzhis rang gi khrud sbyangs nas/ /spros bcas lus sbyangs ngo bo skur/ /smin cing ka dag sa la sbyor/ /spros med dag sbyangs rang bzhin gsung*// smin cing hrun grub nang dbyings sbyor/ /shin tu spros med rig pa thugs/ /smin cing ye shes dbyings su sbyor/ /rab tu spros med sgrib kun sbyangs/ /shes rab skur smin rig bzhi nyid/ /'bras bu sbyor bas ye shes gsum/ /sku gsum dag pas mthar phyin nas/ /kun bzang dbye ba med pa thob/

/de phyir dbang bzhi smin par bya/ /lam ni khregs chod thod ṭhal gnyis/ khregs chod ye yin gzhi thog de/ /'phro gnas gang yin rang bzhag go /de yang shel brar zang thal gyi/ / rig pa stong sangs ṇen pa nyid/ /chos sku zang ma thag bcad la/ /shar gnas mnyam pa'i shes pa gsum/ /dgongs chen gsum gyis nyams su blang*/ /de la dang po gnas pa'i don/ /yul phyir ma 'phros mi kyog pa/ /de nyid rang dus rig pa la/ /stong pas chos nyid skyes med dang*/ /gsal bas 'dzin med longs sku'i ngang*/ /rig la mi kyog sprul sku'i bdag /ngang dngas rang bzhin bdag nyid du/ /rang mal gnas tshe shes par bya/ /de las mi g.yo dgongs pa yin/ /shar ba thugs ṇe'i rang byal du/ /grol ba bzhi yis shes par bya/ /gang brar shar ba'i rig pa de/ /rang grol yin pas gnyen po med/ /cer grol yin pas mthong sar yal/ /shar grol yin pas snga phyi med/ /ye grol yin pas bskyar gzhi med/ /rang grol gnyen po med pa'i gnad/ /gang shar rang gis rang grol phyir/ /cer grol mthong sar yal ba'i gnad/ /gang shar sa der yal ba'i phyir/ /shar grol snga phyi med pa'i gnad/ /gang shar dus 'dir grol ba'i phyir/ / ye grol bskyar gzhi med pa'i gnad/ /gang shar ye nas grol ba'i phyir/ / mtshangs 'di shes pa'i gyal 'byor la/ /kyog pa ched du spang mi dgos/ /rang grol chos sku'i rol par shar/ /thugs ṇe'i byal du snang ba'i phyir/ /mnyam pa'i shes pa bde yangs pa/ /shar dus rang mal gnas pa la/ /gnas dus ngang las 'char ba bzhin/ /ris med gcig tu mngon gyur pas/ /kyogs dang mi kyog bar med 'dres/ /de tshe rang babs rig pa'i don /gang du ma grub med pa la/ / 'dzin byed bral bas phyal pa nyid/ /rang babs gnas pas hrun grub la/ /rig par gcig pas gcig pu nyid/ /thams cad rang byung ye shes dang*/ /snod bcud nam mkha'i ngang gnas gzhin/ /rang snang rang mal ma g.yos pa/ /med pa phyal ba hrun gyis grub/

/gcig pu nyid du mngon gyur pas/ /gdod ma'i zad sar 'khyol ba ste/ /ka dag don las mi 'gyur bas/ khregs chod don gyi man ngag go /thog ma tha ma med dus nas/ /bar med mnyam par gnas pa'i phyir/ / gnas pa shar ba ris med gsum/ /ka dag babs kyi dgongs don du/ khregs chod don gyi snying por gnas/ /de nyid kyogs nas gang bsgom pa/ /'khor ba ming med chen por grol/ /gsang chen nges pa'i man ngag go /thod ṭhal hrun grub rang bzhin gdangs/ /sgron ma bzhi yis nyams blangs pas/ /mngon sum gong 'phel tshad phebs dang*/ /zad pa'i snang ba mthar phyin te/ /ka dag nang dbyings chen po la/ /gzhir snang rang grol chos skur gnas/ /rab gyams tshe 'dir grol tshul lo/ /'bring gyams chos nyid bar do la/ /'od gsal zung 'jug ye shes ngang*/ /hrun grub gzhi snang shar ba'i tshe/ /rang ngo shes pas gyam par grol/ / shar lugs bakhradal gding ṣed pas/ /mngon shes drug dang ṇes dran drug / khrun gyi ting 'dzin la sogs thob/ /thim tshul bakhrad kyis gdod mar grol/ /tha ma chos nyid ma zin pas/ /srid pa'i bar do phyi lam bzhin/ /lam byung gnyid sad tshul tsam du/ /mngon sum mthong ba'i rang shugs kyis/ /rang bzhin sprul par dbugs phyung ste/ /bar do med par sangs khras ṣed/ /dbang po gsum gyi lam du bstan/ /gsum pa 'bras bu'i thob tshul ni/ /gzhi las gzhi snang shar ba nyid/ /rang ngo shes pas ma rig dag /'khrul pa sangs bas mya ngan 'das/ / snang ba dbyings su thim pa las/ /sku gsum chos skur ro gcig pas/ /rang ngo spros bral stong gsal klong*/ /hrun grub thugs ṇe nang gsal te/ kha dog ris med 'char gzhi tsam/ /'byed med thams cad mkhyen par bzhugs/ /gzhi yi ye shes yul dag pas/ /'bras bu grol ba nyid du 'gyur/ /chos sku'i ye shes zhes bya 'o/ /mtshan nyid 'dzin pa 'char gzhi dang*/ /shes bya'i ye shes 'char gzhi las/ /rang ngo spros bral nyid du gnas/

/dper na shel 'od nang gsal lam/ /gnam gang zla ba dbyings 'khyil bzhin/ /de brar chos sku ka dag las/ /'byed med thugs ṇe rang g.yos pas/ /gting gsal 'char gzhi rang gdangs nyid/ /phyi nang 'od gsal 'og min zhing*/ /hrun grub sdug po bkod pa snang*/ /khral ba'i rang snang chen po las/ /zhi khro rang bzhin sprul pa'i zhing*/ / phyogs bcur snang bas don mdzad pa/ /mkha' zla chu zla snang ba bzhin/ /gdul bya dag pa'i don mdzad de/ /zhing dag rin chen snying po na/ /'khor dang longs spyod zad mi shes/ /sku tshe mtha' yas bsam mi khyab/ /chos kyi 'khor lo dpag tu med/ /ye shes dra yi mtshan nyid 'dzin/ /chos dbyings me long mnyam pa nyid// sor kyogs bya grub ye shes so/ /ma dag 'gro drug 'jig kyen du/ /'gro 'dul sprul sku dpag med kyis/ /so so'i 'gro don sna tshogs mdzad/ /shes bya'i ye shes gnyis dang mran/ /ji brar mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyis/ /spyi dang chos nyid stong par mkhyen/ /ji snyed mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyis/ /bye brag chos can snang ba mkhyen/ /gdul bya'i khams dang bsam pa bzhin/ /las bzhin dam chos char pa 'bebs/ /nye bar zhi ba'i bde la 'god/ /'bad pa med par sems can gyi/ /don kun hrun gyis grub pa ni/ /'od gsal mchog gi 'bras bu'o/ /de brar yang zab snying po'i don/ /bla na med pa'i theg pa la/ /bkyen nas grol ba gnyer don du/ /legs par bshad 'di bdag gis so/ /gling 'dir dam chos nyi ma dag /shar ba gang gis bye mo'i bye/ /'od gsal bla med myogs pa che/ / srid pa tha ma'i dam chos nyid/ /bsags pa rab dang skal pa che/ /dbang po yang rab gyur gyams dang*/ /'phrad de de las gzhan du min/ /nges gsang mchog 'di nor bu bzhin/ /ṣed nas dor bar mi bya ste/ /'dod dgu bsgrub phyir gsol ba gdab/ /'bad de babyon pas nan tan bskyed/ /rang bzhin mi zad gter dang 'phrad/ /tshul 'di theg pa khral po yi/

/don la mkhas pa'i gyal 'byor pa/ /sna tshogs rang grol zhes byas bkod/ /dge bas 'gro kun yongs grol shog /mthar thug don gyi snying po zhes bya ba/ /theg pa mchog gi gyal 'byor pa/ /klong chen rab 'byams ky-is gangs ri thod dkar gyi mgul du sbyar ba myogs so// //dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (11)mthar thug don gyi snying po/ - PAGE 204 -- PAGE 203 -- PAGE 200 -
